Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing the electronic payment of utility bills.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to paying utility bills electronically; adding anew section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35.67RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35.92 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 36.94 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 54.16 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 57.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 80.28RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 80.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When a city or town that provides electric, natural gas, water,or sewer services substantially upgrades or replaces their billingsystem, the resulting system must be capable of accepting electronicpayment from residential customers. Additional fees or costs chargedto the customer may not exceed the actual cost of providing anelectronic payment option. The methodology related to electronicpayment shall not affect the terms and conditions of service. (2) For the purposes of this section the following definitionsapply: p. 1 SHB 1034 (a) "Electronic payment" means an internet-based method of paymentthat allows a customer, at the time of payment, to access an internetweb page and transmit text or data controlling the amount of thepayment, the date of the payment, and the account from which thepayment will be made. (b) "Substantially" means a redesign or upgrade of more thantwentyfive percent of the code or database structures of the billingsystem.
